test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

We __talked over__ the matter for two hours; unfortunately, we could not reach a decision.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Discussed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"talked over"** means to discuss a matter or topic with someone, often to reach a decision or to better understand it. (चर्चा करना)

 
 
• **Example:** We talked over the vacation plans to ensure everyone was on the same page.
 
 
 
• **"Discussed"** refers to the act of talking about something with others, typically to exchange ideas or opinions. (विचार-विमर्श करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The team discussed the new strategy for improving sales performance.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct interpretation of "talked over" in the given context is "discussed."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Argued** (तर्क करना): To express opposite views in a conversation or debate.

 
 
• **Example:** They argued about the best way to solve the problem.
 
 
 
• **Quarreled** (झगड़ा करना): To have an angry disagreement with someone.
 
 
• **Example:** The siblings quarreled over who would get the last piece of cake.
 
 
 
• **Debated** (बहस करना): To formally discuss opposing arguments on a particular topic.
 
 
• **Example:** The students debated whether homework should be mandatory.
